name: coordinator-without-repo
description: A coordinator with no repository of its own and a developer that has the workspace's repository. The owner's message to the room wakes the coordinator alone; its wake names the developer as the bot that works on the repository, so it hands the pull request work on with handoff_send instead of refusing it. The developer's dispatch wake follows; nobody is told that no bot has a repository.
